# What government could do: recommendations for the register

*Generated by `alicia/scripts/recommendations_note.py` on 29 October 2026 from `regulation-register/recommendations/` (DECISIONS E-95). Drafts compiled by AI-assisted desk research; not yet checked by a person.*

63 recommendations cover 197 of the 234 register items. Each names the action in plain English, why it would lift productivity or competition, who would act (by default the bodies that administer the items), and the evidence: every source is quoted word for word. 4 recommendations draw on international evidence or practice. The other 37 items have no recommendation, and the reason is recorded in `regulation-register/recommendation-gaps.json` (listed below).

## How they were compiled

- **Sources first.** Each recommendation rests on a review or study that recommends the action: the Productivity Commission (2017, 2023 and its 2025 inquiries), the Harper competition review, the Henry tax review, the NSW Productivity Commission, Treasury reviews and overseas regulators. Where no source recommending a specific action was found, no recommendation was written.
- **Quotes checked.** Every quote was checked word for word against the full text of the downloaded document, except 0 marked as read from a web page.
- **Not reached.** Some publishers refuse automated access (the ACCC, the OECD, the IMF, the Grattan Institute and several Commonwealth department sites), so their reports could not be quoted. ACCC findings appear only where a reachable government document reports them.
- **Productivity only.** Like the framework, the recommendations weigh productivity and competition. Where an item serves health, safety or environmental goals, the trade-offs are noted, not weighed.

## Items without a recommendation

| Item | Why |
|---|---|
| National small amount credit contract regime and cost caps (CTH) | No recent review recommendation was reached. |
| Australia Post's reserved letter service (CTH) | No Australian review recommending removal of the reserved service was found, and international sources (EU postal liberalisation) could not be accessed. |
| Major Bank Levy (CTH) | No review recommendation on the levy was found. |
| Petroleum Retail Marketing Sites and Franchise Acts repealed; Oilcode introduced (CTH) | No review recommendation on the Oilcode was found. |
| Vapes restricted to pharmacy supply (CTH) | A health measure; no productivity-focused review recommendation was found. |
| Wheat export single desk abolished (CTH) | The reform is complete; no further recommendation was found. |
| Default Market Offer price cap (2 items) | The ACCC recommended a default offer in 2018; no later review recommending a specific change was reached. |
| Right to disconnect (CTH) | No independent review of this 2024 change was found yet. |
| Same Job Same Pay orders for labour hire (CTH) | No independent review of these 2023 changes was found yet. |
| Next-day fuel price commitment, MyFuel NT (2 items) | These schemes are new (2026) and no evaluation or review recommendation was found; the evidence on similar schemes is mixed. |
| Mandatory fuel price reporting, FuelCheck (6 items) | Evidence on whether real-time price reporting lowers prices is mixed, and no review recommending a specific change was found in the sources that could be reached (the ACCC's petrol monitoring reports could not be accessed). |
| Future Gaming Market: end of the Federal Group gaming monopoly (2 items) | No review recommendation on gaming market structure was found. |
| Concerted practices prohibition and other Harper CCA reforms (2 items) | These changes followed the Harper review's own recommendations; no later review recommending change was found. |
| Mandatory Dairy Code of Conduct (CTH) | No recent review recommendation was reached; the ACCC, which hosts much of the relevant analysis, refuses automated access. |
| Remade Franchising Code of Conduct (CTH) | The code was remade in 2025 after a review; no later recommendation was found. |
| New mandatory Horticulture Code of Conduct (CTH) | No recent review recommendation was reached; the ACCC, which hosts much of the relevant analysis, refuses automated access. |
| Sugar Industry Code of Conduct (CTH) | No recent review recommendation was found. |
| Legal Profession Uniform Law (3 items) | No current review recommending that the remaining states and territories join the Uniform Law was found. |
| Mandatory and suspensory merger notification regime (CTH) | The regime began in 2026 and is too new for review recommendations. |
| Minimum floor price for alcohol (NT) | A public health measure adopted on health evidence; no productivity-focused recommendation was found. |
| 60-day dispensing of PBS medicines (CTH) | No review recommendation on 60-day dispensing was found. |
| Short-term rental accommodation framework: code, register and Sydney 180-night cap (3 items) | The evidence on whether caps, registers and levies return homes to long-term rental is contested, and no review recommending a specific change was found. |
| Small bar licence (2 items) | No review recommending extending small bar licences to other states was found. |
